author: kevak
body:
## About The Pull Request

This adds a 0pt spell to the mage buylist that makes the caster and only the caster die horribly and then explode into gibs. The sound is _horrid_ and I adore it.

Mages get a prompt to back out rather than carrying out the casting.

This was my inspiration. [:3](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r1cTTsjPH-g)

## Why It's Good For The Game

Firstly as a mage main, I think it'd be really funny. But also it makes sense that mages would have the option to kill themselves as a last resort to avoid fates worse than death. That and it'd be _great_ for punctuating how boring someone's shitty mechanical zape erp is. Just explode and traumatize them! 

If added I'd expect it to get used a fair bit by curious mage players for a week or two, and then only get used rarely to get out of shitty erp in an explosive manner afterwards.

author: rfellows
body:
# Summary

[NIFI-14185](https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/NIFI-14185)
Migrated to Nx latest (20). This also upgraded to Angular 19. This PR is everything required for those changes to be complete.

In angular 19, the default component type is standalone. So if you do not declare it `standalone: false`, it will be true. This change had ramifications including needing to upgrade some 3rd party components to make them compatible as well as relaxing an eslint rule from error to warn when declaring a component as `standalone: false`.

There were a couple of new compiler errors that showed up as a result of the upgrade too. These were solved in this PR as well.

One particular change to mention, the mat-expand-panel had some behavior changes that made scrolling the contents of the documentation panel on load not work properly. You will see in this PR that we now initialize state of the desired expanded panel based on the current route and control its expanded state through properties on the class rather than assume the `openAll` method on the accordion will complete in time before the attempt to scroll happens.

author: fuzzybinary
body:
### What and why?

Instead of using the time reported by the native SDKs when we perform RUM actions, we're going to use the time reported by Dart / Flutter before it is transferred to the native platform. This should be more accurate, as it won't be slowed by the amount of time it takes the method channel to process.

refs: RUM-8246

### How?

Native SDKs already support the `_dd.timestamp` attribute for RUM actions to specify when they occurred. Add this to all calls where a timestamp is needed.

author: chichun-charlie-liu
body:
<!-- Thank you for the contribution! -->

### Description of the change

In addition to CUTLASS kernel, we added a new Triton matmul kernel that supports FP32, FP16, BF16, FP8, and INT8. Triton kernel is more flexible and easier hackable than CUTLASS. Although the INT8 performance of this triton kernel is only on par with FP16 `torch.matmul` (CUTLASS is ~2x faster), triton provides a valuable path to study HW behaviors and detailed simulations. For example, we can apply truncation on accumulator in a more efficient way than serial `torch.matmul` and much cleaner codes compared to writing in CUTLASS.

### Related issue number

There is a compatibility issue with our existing CUTLASS kernel and `torch.compile(..., mode=reduced-overhead)`, which is blocking us from advancing from `PyTorch 2.3` to `PyTorch 2.4`. With the addition of the new Triton kernel, at least there is an alternative run path for the entire INT8 QAT example (including the lowering part) when using `PyTorch 2.4`.

### How to verify the PR

INT8 QAT example has a lowering option which previously only supported CUTLASS. With the newly added Triton kernel, we have a second option to run quantized model using real INT engine now. 

Note that in this model lowering experiment, quantized model will pass real INT8 tensor to matmul operator. Therefore, the kernel needs to be able to:
1. accept INT8 tensors (torch.matmul do not accept INT8 inputs yet), 
2. use the INT engine in the best way it can
3. return from INT8 matmul is a INT32 tensor. Dequantization will be performed afterward.

author: alecgalingit
body: This PR introduces functionality for an LLM summary to be generated, streamed, and saved to the Postgres database after a user navigates to a lecture slide. The loader in "lectures_.$lectureId.slides.$slideNumber.tsx" is updated to get the generateStatus for the slide--if generateStatus is null, an EventStream is created which listens to a summary that begins to be produced within "completion.tsx" using the OpenAI API, and the LLM summary is streamed to the user. If this LLM summary already exists, it is simply retrieved from the database. If the user leaves a page during the streaming process, the EventStream connection is closed, but the backend continues generating the LLM summary and uploads it to the database, When the user navigates back to the slide after leaving it during the streaming process, this LLM summary is displayed if it is ready; otherwise "processing..." is displayed.

code: Очистили и улучшили код переключения полноэкранного режима и строки состояния для лучшей работы.   <!-- Cleaned up some fullscreen and status bar toggle code to function better (www.github.com/tgstation/tgstation/pull/89110) -->
/:cl:

## Summary by Sourcery

Update dependencies, refactor quirk processing, add directional firelock frames, and fix various bugs. Add sounds to headsets. Move geese to the basic mob subsystem.

New Features:
- Added directional firelock frames, which are properly repairable and deconstructable.
- Added the TRAIT_NOSOFTCRIT, which prevents falling into a regenerative coma.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed firelock construction not updating icons properly.
- Regen meshes now stop when they have completed their task.
- Fixed two typos in the banded snake description.
- Dangerous teleportation with the hand teleporter is working again.
- Premium and contraband vending machine products now have no discount.
- Fixed quirk menu changes not being reflected when switching tabs.
- Fixed list input scrolling and search bar focus issues.
- Fixed shuttle parallax when a mob is standing still.
- Fixed a fullscreen toggle issue that could make the window too small.

author: bbean23
body:
## Purpose

Add code that handle the transforms of image coordinates to real-world units of measurement.

## Summary of changes

Adds the PerspectiveTransform class with the following methods:
- transform_image: performs the forward transform from pixel to orthographic coordinates
- pixels_to_meters: translates pixel coordinates into Cartesian values
- meters_to_pixels: translates Cartesian values into pixel coordinates

## Implementation notes

Only applies to 2 dimensions. This means that the coordinate system for the translated values must be only exist in 2 dimensions. For example, a target board and camera that share a normal vector, and which vector is on one of the X, Y, or Z axes, will fulfill these requirements.
